usageNote: 表示'无数次'的夸张说法，口语超常用！比'many times'更有力，透露出一种'我真的做烂了'的感觉😂

examples.en: I've watched that movie hundreds of times and never get tired of it.
examples.zh: 那部电影我看了无数遍，怎么都看不腻。

examples.en: She has practiced this song hundreds of times before the concert.
examples.zh: 演唱会前她把这首歌练了上百遍。
